widgets_values:
image_qwen_image_2512_360_panorama

The editable version of a ComfyQ bundle, generated from its .api.json
through ComfyUI's own frontend (tools/api-to-ui).

ComfyQ RUNS the .api.json, not this file. Edit here, then re-export
through tools/ui-to-api/convert.mjs to change what actually runs.

nodes.title: Consignes 360 (EN, fixes)
widgets_values: Full spherical outdoor view, straight horizon in the exact middle, seamless left and right edges, continuous sky at the top, continuous ground at the bottom, one single coherent place with the same lighting, sun direction, weather, colours and time of day everywhere. Sharp photographic detail, natural textures on grass, foliage, bark and walls, realistic daylight and shadows, real camera photograph, not an illustration, not a 3D render. No people, no text, no frame, no vignette.
